name: GridDistortion-TS-TW
title: Grid Distortion
blurb: An image warps and ripples dynamically under your cursor.
description: Three.js component rendering an image on a shader-based grid that distorts based on cursor movement. Uses a data texture to propagate distortion physics with relaxation, creating wave-like ripple effects.
use_when: You want an interactive, tactile image effect that responds to user movement with smooth fluid distortion.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or performance-critical contexts — runs continuous WebGL rendering.
a11y: Purely visual cursor-driven effect; no keyboard alternative or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
